source: synthetic: a deprecated logging call spread over 20 modules, an alias, a re-export and a comment
prompt: `oldLog` in src/log.ts is deprecated. Move every use in src/ to the `log` API (log.<level>(msg), or log.at(level, msg) when the level is a variable), then remove oldLog completely, including any re-export, so that the name no longer appears anywhere in src/. Logged lines must stay exactly the same. Do not change the tests. Run `bun test` until it passes.
